purpose: Maintain historical NFL team/game facts and convenience summaries for readable SU, ATS and O/U interface context. Example tidbits must not be interpreted as privileged model categories or user-requested predictive features.

outcomes.ATS: team margin versus historical spread_line; unavailable when spread_line is missing
outcomes.OU: combined final score versus historical total_line; unavailable when total_line is missing

guardrails: Historical spread and total may describe past ATS/O-U results but may not rewrite the football projection.
A historical tidbit is context, not causation and not a standalone BET/LEAN recommendation.
Missing spread or total is unknown and excluded from that market record denominator, never treated as zero or a push.
If opponent-record context is shown, it must use the opponent record entering that game, never end-of-season record.
Do not turn a user example into a privileged predictive category.
Do not mine arbitrary tiny-sample combinations merely because they create an extreme record.
No historical pattern receives predictive weight until separately backtested and promoted under model governance.
next_step: Generate generic current-matchup interface tidbits from verifiable historical facts; predictive weighting is a separate optional research path.
